pages.text: Epic Vanguard adds $(thing)mercenary companions$(): warriors you hire with $(item)Gold Coins$(), equip, and lead into battle.$(br2)They level up, belong to a $(thing)class$() with its own warcry, eat and drink potions on their own and follow you through teleports and dimensions.
With $(item)Epic Fight$() installed, companions fight with its animations. Without it, they use regular Minecraft combat.
